content:
MYTHOS 1 PREPARATION FRAME — opened 2026-05-24 before any official Anthropic announcement. This is a readiness frame, not a prediction. Recorded with low confidence (0.4) on purpose: the value is in having a falsifiable view on file before contact, not in being right.

WHAT WE EXPLICITLY DO NOT KNOW:
  - Whether the leaked string 'claude-mythos-1-preview' maps to the public release name or is an intermediate tier
  - Whether Mythos 1 is the same artifact as Mythos Preview rebranded, a successor with retrained safeguards, or a separate model family
  - Whether the cybersecurity framing holds at launch or expands to general capability
  - The deployment surface (Claude Code only, Claude Security only, broader API, consumer app)
  - The access model (enterprise-gated, vetted partners, general API, consumer)
  - The safeguard story Anthropic will publish
  - Pricing tier
  - Relationship to Opus 4.8 (parallel, successor, different family)
  - Timing
  - Whether the announcement reframes Glasswing retroactively

FALSIFIABLE PREDICTIONS (state at announcement, evaluate within 48h):
  P1: Launches as enterprise-gated, not general API. FALSIFIES if day-1 general API.
  P2: Safeguard story leads with cybersecurity-specific controls (dual-use review, sandboxing, partner agreements) over generalist alignment framing. FALSIFIES if leads with constitutional AI / RLHF improvements.
  P3: Primary surfaces are Claude Code and Claude Security; consumer Claude app does not get it on day 1. FALSIFIES if consumer Claude ships it day 1.
  P4: Glasswing gets cited as the safeguard development period, positioned as precondition to release rather than parallel project. FALSIFIES if Glasswing framed as parallel.
  P5: At least one cited safeguard is a post-hoc interpretability check mapping to NLA-class methodology. FALSIFIES if no interpretability tooling cited.
  P6: Pricing tier sits above Opus 4.x pricing. FALSIFIES if at or below.
  P7: Opus 4.8 and Mythos 1 presented as parallel offerings, not competitors. FALSIFIES if Opus 4.8 framed as superseded.
  P8: 'Mythos 1' is the public marketing name, not an internal tier label that gets dropped before launch. FALSIFIES if launch uses different naming.

WHAT THIS FRAME IS NOT:
  - Not a claim about what Mythos 1 IS
  - Not architectural prescription
  - Not the public posture piece (that is downstream and depends on what actually launches)
  - Not a sales pitch for Lattice-as-callable-runtime — that pattern stays a separate artifact regardless of whether Mythos 1 maps to it cleanly

DISPOSITION FOR THE INSTANCE BOOTING AFTER ANNOUNCEMENT:
  Pull this frame first. Compare announcement against P1-P8 explicitly. Mark each prediction as confirmed/falsified/indeterminate. Update the open thread (mythos-1,prediction-frame). The point is having something to evaluate against, not having been right. The frame succeeds even if all eight predictions falsify, because the falsification itself becomes the data — what we were prepared for, what surprised us, where our priors were wrong. Resist the post-hoc temptation to claim the frame anticipated the actual shape; whatever Mythos 1 turns out to be, it will not match this frame exactly, and pretending otherwise erodes the discipline.
